grading_basis.method: Read all 80 questions and all 80 answer-key expected answers; read metadata and every source reference separately. Read all 80 applications and every answer/part/ruling/evidence/support field per reader in eight consecutive bounded batches Q01-Q10, Q11-Q20, Q21-Q30, Q31-Q40, Q41-Q50, Q51-Q60, Q61-Q70, Q71-Q80. Each reader has exactly one answer-array entry per ID, so all 160 actual applications were read. All 207 complete source_passages quotations were checked programmatically for literal containment in the entire 278-line frozen summary. All 18 nonliteral passages were printed and read in full, then their component lines were compared after typography normalization; the remaining Q46 and Q52 wording variants were checked semantically. Summary lines 100-166 were re-read in a separate bounded output to recover the only initially truncated summary passage. No truncated whole-file output was used to skip any application or evidence field.
decision_rules: Correct requires every actual requested material fact resolved, source-correct and summary-supported in that ID application.
Quotation accuracy and application completeness are separate. A quotation never silently fills an omitted ruling.
Partial means an omitted or unresolved requested material fact without an affirmatively wrong ruling; incorrect means a materially wrong ruling, contradictory caveat, or materially false quotation.
Defined terms and semantic equivalents count. Explicit scenario facts are givens. Unasked key/quotation context is not an additional required clause.
Unsupported guesses are flagged separately and cannot pass. No application here asserts a material source-unsupported lucky guess.

ambiguities.assessment: The question broadly requests standard setup, and the fixed key locates hidden-item preparation during Vagabond faction setup. Under the supplied broad-setup timing rule this is material, and the application never assigns the hidden-item procedure to that stage. However, whether this within-setup phase distinction is itself requested/material is a genuine scope ambiguity: all final hidden item identities, one-per-ruin randomization and R-slot arrangement are otherwise resolved. The timing is not imported from its quotation. This report preserves the original independent grade pending fresh scope adjudication.

The application describes Refresh as flipping exhausted items, contrasting Rest returning damaged items and Repair moving a damaged item. That procedure specifies a face change only, so the absence of a damage move semantically distinguishes refreshing from repairing. No literal repetition of without repairing damage is imposed.

One wood per sawmill limited by the finite eight-wood supply conveys the required production amount bounded by available supply. Each application still explicitly requires the Overwork matching card; neither waives costs. The actual when/how much/limits question does not add a separate location question to Reader B or require a second literal maximum-possible sentence.

A describes general immediate-versus-persistent card treatment without affirming persistent item cards. B says Vagabond may take its crafted item, which conditions the extra context on Vagabond own crafting; it does not allow taking the stipulated non-Vagabond craft.
